Dots Phone

Let Dots make the call.

Give it the call you’ve been putting off. Dots can talk to customer service for you, using the information and apps you choose to share.

Get started ↗

Finding out where the washing machine is.

Product walkthrough / 24 seconds

Jamie asks Dots to call about a replacement washing machine. Dots saves a briefing before dialing, answers from it, then checks an allowed Gmail source for a missing delivery reference. The store confirms Friday, 9 am–1 pm.

Scripted conversation with fictional email. No calls or inbox access. Timing is compressed.

Your setup

You choose
what it can use.

Set the limits in the brief.

Include what Dots may share and agree to. The document is saved before the call starts.

Connect the apps you want.

Codex uses the read tools you allow for that call. Email access is optional and requires authentication.

Keep the service on your machine.

Call records are encrypted locally. Model requests go to OpenAI; phone audio travels through Twilio.
